rule: The product works point and click, always. No bootstrap step, doc, report, card or error tells a person to create, copy, paste or save a token, secret, key or setting, or to run a command. Credentials arrive through a consent screen (OAuth / GitHub App) and are stored and refreshed by the Worker.
owner_directive: Rowan, 2026-11-13: the user never has to do these manual actions; point and click for everything, always.

connect_link.rule: CONNECT-LINK-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-17): every owner action is one link to a web UI that runs OAuth/OIDC and its callbacks behind the scenes (like /connect/github). A card without `connect` and `connect_kind` fails the check. connect_kind is `connect-flow` (a page on ultrastable.io under /connect) or `provider-deep-link` (a deep link to a provider's own page, allowed only for the ids in `deep_link_baseline`, which only shrinks as flows replace them).
